papers.title: Untangling the effects of within-host and between-host natural selection in viruses with applications to evolution of HIV-1 co-receptor usage
authors: on behalf of the PANGEA Consortium
papers.venue: Journal of The Royal Society Interface
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  The fitness of a pathogen can be characterized at multiple levels corresponding to different life cycle stages. Typically, epidemiological studies for measuring pathogen fitness compute a single selection coefficient for pathogen variants that encompasses the entire lifecycle. However, evolution towards greater fitness within hosts can potentially compromise transmissibility. To address this, we develop a population-genetic model and software for the inference of multi-level selection coefficients. Our approach builds on population-genetic models previously applied to macro-evolution, whereby speciation and extinction rates are state-dependent. We relate this state dependence to within- and between-host selection. Evolution of beneficial phenotypes within hosts may occur rapidly (higher ‘speciation’), but reduce rates of dispersal between hosts (higher ‘extinction’). This new coalescent-based method improves on existing multi-state speciation and extinction models by accounting for highly nonlinear population dynamics and variable sampling through time, making it suitable for epidemiology. We characterize the accuracy of this method using birth–death and coalescent simulations before analysing a real dataset of HIV-1 genetic sequences. We quantified the multi-level relative fitness underlying HIV-1 ‘co-receptor switching’. In accordance with previous observations, we estimate that the relative transmissibility of X4-tropic virus is 9%, while within-host switching to X4-tropism is approximately 7-fold higher than switching to R5-tropism, indicating a strong within-host and between-host trade-off of co-receptor usage.

papers.title: Quasi-Holding Model as a Governance Innovation for Sustainable Pesantren Business Entities: A Study of Maqashid Syariah
papers.abstract: dilemma between pursuing business profits and maintaining their social and religious missions in achieving sustainable economic independence. This study aims to formulate a sustainable, independent pesantren business governance model that preserves spiritual and religious values. The research uses a qualitative descriptive case study approach at Darul Ulum Banyuanyar Islamic Boarding School, employing interviews, documents, data triangulation, and interactive analysis based on the Miles, Huberman, and Saldana model. The findings show that the pesantren successfully integrates 23 business units through a quasi-holding model, strengthened by spiritual capital such as Kiai charisma, tawadhu culture, and a barakah orientation, thereby creating synergy and stable governance. From the Maqashid Sharia perspective, the model protects hifzh al-mal through annual surplus accumulation, strengthens hifzh ad-din through da’wah and education, supports hifzh al-aql and hifzh al-nafs through low tuition fees of IDR 35,000 per month, and forms morally grounded yet business-competent generations. The conclusion is that the spiritual-based quasi-holding model harmonizes business, education, and religious values in a sustainable governance system. The significance of this study lies in its contribution to the development of pesantren governance models based on Maqashid Sharia and Islamic social entrepreneurship principles.

papers.title: Monitoring Hierarchies in Knowledge Production
papers.abstract: We study peer monitoring design in knowledge production. A principal leads agents who work on different but related tasks. By working on their own tasks, agents acquire information that is useful for evaluating their peers' performance. We consider robust contracts under which effort by all agents is the unique rationalizable outcome. The optimal contract induces a hierarchy of monitoring authority: agents easier for the principal to monitor directly are assigned greater authority to evaluate other agents. Task diversity improves information value but weakens peer monitoring. This tension distorts optimal public task assignment toward the principal's core expertise. Confidential random assignment relaxes this distortion by decoupling information production from the perceived monitoring structure.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了知识生产中的同伴监督机制设计。一位主管负责管理从事不同但相关任务的代理人。通过完成各自的任务，代理人能够获得评估同伴表现所需的信息。我们考虑了这样一种契约安排：在这种契约下，所有代理人的努力行为是唯一可被合理解释的结果。最优契约会形成一种监督权限的层级结构——主管更容易直接监督的代理人被赋予更大的权力来评估其他代理人。任务多样性虽然提升了信息价值，但削弱了同伴之间的监督效果。这种矛盾导致公共任务的最优分配偏向于主管的核心专业领域。而通过随机分配任务的方式，则能够将信息生产与感知到的监督结构分离，从而缓解这种扭曲现象。。

papers.title: dexamine: A Python package for Uniswap event data on Ethereum
papers.abstract: Decentralized exchanges record trading and liquidity provision on public blockchains, but empirical analysis requires interpreting these records and linking them to execution metadata. dexamine is a Python package that parses Uniswap v2 and v3 events on Ethereum. It converts transaction receipt logs into observations of trades and liquidity changes, with token quantities, pool state, transaction order, and gas information. The package separates data retrieval, contract metadata, protocol interpretation, and output construction. The repository provides recorded Ethereum responses and an offline reproducible example, and version 1 has been used to construct data for an empirical study of price discovery in decentralized markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】去中心化交易所在公共区块链上记录交易和流动性提供情况，但实证分析需要对这些记录进行解读，并将其与交易执行元数据关联起来。dexamine是一个Python软件包，能够解析以太坊上的Uniswap v2和v3交易事件。该软件包将交易接收日志转换为关于交易和流动性变化的详细信息，包括代币数量、资金池状态、交易顺序以及Gas费用等数据。该软件包将数据检索、合约元数据解析、协议解读以及结果生成等功能分离开来。其代码仓库提供了记录在案的以太坊响应数据以及可供离线复现的示例代码；其中第1.0版本已被用于构建关于去中心化市场价格发现机制的实证研究数据。。

papers.title: Discouragement under institutional uncertainty: entrepreneurial sensemaking and self-rationing in SME finance during crisis
papers.abstract:
This study examines how business owners (BOs) interpret institutional uncertainty and how such interpretations shape small and medium-sized enterprises’ (SMEs) financing behaviour. Focusing on Brexit in the United Kingdom, it investigates how sensemaking and behavioural mechanisms generate discouragement and self-rationing in accessing external finance.
 
 
 
 Adopting a constructive grounded theory approach, the study draws on twenty semi-structured interviews with UK SME owners conducted between December 2021 and January 2023. An abductive analysis was employed to develop a process-based explanation linking institutional uncertainty, entrepreneurial sensemaking, and financing behaviour.
 
 
 
 The findings show that institutional uncertainty does not simply constrain credit but reshapes entrepreneurial behaviour through interpretive and structural mechanisms. BOs translate uncertainty into heightened perceived risk, leading to precautionary sensemaking and consequent self-rationing even where credit remains available. Discouragement emerged as a multi-mechanistic process shaped by anticipated rejection, vicarious experiences, procedural burden, higher costs, imposter-related doubt, and perceived discrimination. Gender differences under uncertainty are not uniform in magnitude but mechanism-specific, with women experiencing stronger relational and identity-based barriers and men exhibiting more mindset-driven conservatism. Fintech-enabled lending mitigates discouragement by reducing relational and procedural barriers.
 
 
 
 This study extends discouragement theory by conceptualising it as an emergent and dynamic process of sensemaking under institutional uncertainty. It further integrates sensemaking and behavioural finance to offer a behavioural explanation for credit market disengagement. Additionally, it extends pecking order theory by identifying a behaviourally constructed pecking order, where sensemaking and self-rationing emerge endogenously through cognitive, social and identity-based mechanisms.

papers.title: Can agricultural finance mitigate supply chain vulnerability? Evidence from the cotton industry in China
papers.abstract:
Improving the resilience of the cotton supply chain is critical for advancing high-quality industrial development and securing the supply chain of the textile industry. As a core instrument for optimizing resource allocation and easing financing constraints, agricultural financial services may foster supply chain resilience.
 
 
 
 Based on panel data from 12 major cotton-producing provinces in China covering 2014-2023, this study employs fixed-effects models and mediation models to examine the impact of agricultural financial service development on cotton supply chain resilience and its underlying mechanisms, with resilience and financial service levels measured by the entropy method.
 
 
 
 (1) The development of agricultural financial services significantly improves cotton supply chain resilience. (2) These services strengthen resilience primarily by enhancing total factor productivity (TFP) in cotton production. (3) Positive effects are observed across all four sub-dimensions of resilience (resistance, recovery, restructuring, and renewal capacity); the facilitating effect on renewal capacity ranks the highest, while that on recovery capacity is the weakest.
 
 
 
 The findings reveal a TFP-based transmission channel and heterogeneous effects across resilience sub-dimensions, providing targeted policy implications for optimizing financial support for the cotton industry.

papers.title: KEEFEKTIFAN MODEL PROBLEM BASED LEARNING TERHADAP HASIL BELAJAR MATEMATIKA MATERI DATA KELAS V SDN SONEYAN 01 PATI
papers.venue: SCIENCE Jurnal Inovasi Pendidikan Matematika dan IPA
papers.abstract:
This research was motivated by the low mathematics learning outcomes of fifth-grade students at SDN Soneyan 01 Pati on the topic of data, caused by teacher-centered instruction and limited active student involvement in understanding data presentation and interpretation. This study aimed to determine the effectiveness of the Problem Based Learning (PBL) model on students' mathematics learning outcomes on the data topic. A quantitative method with a Pre-Experimental One-Group Pretest-Posttest Design was applied in April–May 2026, involving 18 fifth-grade students selected through saturated sampling. Data were collected using a 16-item multiple-choice test that had been tested for validity, reliability, difficulty level, and discriminating power, supplemented by observation, interviews, and documentation. The results showed that the average posttest score increased significantly from 65.28 to 86.50, demonstrating a meaningful gain in conceptual understanding. The paired sample t-test yielded a t-count of 28.87, which was greater than the t-table value of 2.110 at a significance level of 0.05, indicating that the alternative hypothesis was accepted. The average N-Gain score was 0.6594, categorized as moderate, and classical learning mastery reached 94.44%. Based on these findings, it can be concluded that the Problem Based Learning model is effective in improving fifth-grade students' mathematics learning outcomes on the data topic.
ABSTRAK
Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya hasil belajar matematika siswa kelas V SDN Soneyan 01 Pati pada materi data yang disebabkan oleh pembelajaran yang masih berpusat pada guru serta kurangnya keterlibatan aktif siswa dalam memahami penyajian dan penafsiran data. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis keefektifan model Problem Based Learning (PBL) terhadap hasil belajar matematika materi data pada siswa kelas V. Penelitian kuantitatif dengan desain Pre-Experimental One-Group Pretest-Posttest Design ini dilaksanakan pada bulan April hingga Mei 2026, melibatkan 18 siswa kelas V sebagai sampel melalui teknik saturated sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan instrumen tes pilihan ganda sebanyak 16 butir soal yang telah diuji validitas, reliabilitas, taraf kesukaran, dan daya pembeda, serta dilengkapi observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya peningkatan kemampuan kognitif yang signifikan, ditandai dengan kenaikan rerata posttest dari 65,28 menjadi 86,50. Hasil pengujian paired sample t-test menghasilkan nilai t_"hitung"  sebesar 28,87 yang lebih besar daripada t_"tabel"  sebesar 2,110 (α=0,05), yang mengindikasikan bahwa perlakuan memberikan dampak positif secara statistik. Peningkatan pemahaman siswa tergolong dalam kategori sedang dengan rerata N-Gain sebesar 0,6594, serta menghasilkan pencapaian ketuntasan belajar klasikal yang sangat tinggi yaitu 94,44%. Berdasarkan temuan empiris tersebut, dapat disimpulkan bahwa penerapan model Problem Based Learning terbukti efektif dalam meningkatkan hasil belajar matematika materi data pada siswa kelas V sekolah dasar.

papers.title: High Volume Low Complexity Surgical Hubs in England: Can They Improve Physician Productivity?
papers.abstract: Whether organisational separation of elective and emergency care improves physician productivity remains an open question. Most existing evidence relies on cross-sectional comparisons or volume-based outcomes that cannot isolate efficiency gains from input expansion or provider selection. In contrast, this paper exploits the staggered rollout of NHS England's surgical hub programme, a set of dedicated ring-fenced elective facilities introduced as part of its Elective Recovery Plan, to provide causal estimates of the effect of elective-emergency separation on physician productivity. Using this rollout to implement a heterogeneity-robust difference-in-differences design, we estimate the impact of hub adoption on physician productivity measured as cost-weighted elective output per unit of salary-weighted physician input. We find that hub adoption increases physician productivity by 14.5% relative to the no-hub counterfactual, accompanied by a 10-day (7.6%) reduction in average patient waiting times. The size of these gains depends on how completely elective care is insulated from emergency pathways. Standalone hubs situated on dedicated elective-only sites achieve relatively larger productivity gains than integrated hubs located within main acute hospital sites. Moreover, operating multiple hubs yields gains more than double the overall average, whereas a single hub shows no statistically significant effect. For health systems seeking to raise physician productivity and address elective backlogs, these findings suggest that how separation is implemented, not simply whether it is adopted, shapes the productivity gains it delivers.

papers.title: Italian Business-to-Business Invoicing Data: A Network Analysis
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive description of the network of Italian Business-to-Business commercial relationships, based on the universe of electronic invoices collected by the Italian Tax Office. The firm-to-firm detail of the data is exploited to describe the distribution of the numbers of buyers (customers) and sellers (suppliers) per firm, the centrality of each firm in the production network, and the average distance between firms. We characterize for the first time the firm-to-firm network describing the Italian production system, and present its geographic and sectoral breakdown. The analysis reveals heavy tailed distributions for the numbers of buyers and sellers per firm, implying a scale-free structure of the network. The distributions of centrality values display heavy tails as well, indicating a strong concentration of importance in a relatively small number of firms. We estimate the tail exponents for all these distributions, finding in all cases lower exponents for downstream (buyer-side) distributions than for the upstream (seller-side) ones.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们基于意大利税务局收集的电子发票数据，全面描述了意大利企业间商业关系的网络结构。通过分析这些数据中的企业间交互细节，我们了解了每家企业的买家（客户）和卖家（供应商）数量分布、企业在生产网络中的中心性以及企业间的平均距离。我们首次对描述意大利生产系统的企业间网络进行了系统分析，并对其进行了地理和行业层面的细分。研究发现，企业买家和卖家数量的分布具有重尾特性，表明该网络具有无标度结构；中心性值的分布同样呈现重尾特征，说明大部分重要性集中在少数企业手中。我们对所有这些分布的尾部指数进行了估算，结果发现下游（买家端）分布的尾部指数低于上游（卖家端）分布的尾部指数。。

papers.title: Strategic communication of narratives: An experiment
papers.abstract: We investigate the strategic communication of narratives under model uncertainty. The sender has private information about the true data-generating process of publicly observable data. The receiver is uncertain about how to interpret the data, but aware of the sender's incentives to strategically provide interpretations (``narratives''). We theoretically show that the size of the conflict of interest between the sender and the receiver is a crucial determinant of equilibrium communication. In particular, the stronger the sender's bias, (i) the more senders exaggerate their information and (ii) the more receivers correct the sender's action recommendations. In a laboratory experiment, we find evidence in line with both predictions, suggesting that people in complex and uncertain environments take a narrator's strategic incentives into account. Additional analyses reveal that narrative likelihood does not drive receiver behavior and that narratives are, on average, slightly persuasive only when bias is low.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在模型不确定性下叙事的策略性沟通行为。发送者掌握有关公开可观测数据的真实生成过程的私有信息，而接收者则不确定如何解读这些数据，但知道发送者有动机通过叙事来传递特定信息。我们从理论上证明了发送者与接收者之间的利益冲突程度是决定沟通结果的关键因素：发送者的偏见越强，（i）其夸大信息的程度就越高；（ii）接收者纠正发送者建议的倾向也就越明显。在实验室实验中，我们发现了与这两种预测相符的证据，表明人们在复杂且充满不确定性的环境中会考虑叙事背后的策略性动机。进一步分析表明，叙事的可信度并不会直接影响接收者的行为；只有当偏见较低时，叙事才具有轻微的说服力。。研究方法：实验方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Do wind and solar curtail at negative electricity prices? Incentives and evidence across two decades of German renewable support schemes
papers.abstract: In many power systems, wind and solar generation increasingly often exceeds electricity demand. Curtailing renewable generation in those hours matters both for prices and for the physical stability of the grid. Turning off wind turbines and solar panels is technically easier than ramping down a large power station, yet support schemes often give renewables an economic incentive to keep producing at negative prices. This paper studies wind and solar energy in Germany. For each cohort of generators it estimates, hour by hour, the incentive implied by two decades of support policy. It then sets those incentives against observed behavior, using a new estimate of market-based curtailment built from reanalysis weather data. I find that in 2025, at prices below -50 EUR/MWh, almost all wind generators had an incentive to stop producing, but only half of them did. Solar is the opposite case: nearly two thirds of the potential had no incentive to curtail at all, mostly because it receives a feed-in tariff that shields it from wholesale prices. Of the exposed remainder, just over a fifth cut production. Low exposure and response rates inflate subsidy payments and make the power system harder to operate safely. I conclude that a further expansion of wind and solar requires them to respond to price signals.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在许多电力系统中，风能和太阳能发电量日益超过电力需求。在这些时段削减可再生能源的发电量对电价以及电网的物理稳定性都具有重要影响。从技术角度来看，关闭风力涡轮机和太阳能电池板比降低大型发电厂的出力要容易得多；然而，现有的补贴政策往往为可再生能源提供了在经济上继续发电的激励（即使发电价格处于负值）。本文研究了德国的风能和太阳能发电情况。针对每一类发电设施，本文逐小时分析了二十年来补贴政策所带来的激励效应，并将这些激励效应与实际发电行为进行对比（数据基于重新分析后的天气数据得出的市场基准削减量）。研究发现：到2025年，当电价降至-50欧元/兆瓦时，几乎所有风力发电设施都有停止发电的动机，但实际上只有约一半的设施真正采取了这一措施。太阳能发电的情况则相反——近三分之二的太阳能发电设施完全没有削减发电量的动机，主要是因为它们获得了上网电价补贴，从而免受批发电价的影响。在那些仍需削减发电量的设施中，仅有五分之一左右实际减少了发电量。由于发电设施对价格信号的响应程度较低，补贴支出相应增加，这使得电力系统的安全运行变得更加困难。因此，本文认为要进一步发展风能和太阳能发电，必须让这些能源更好地响...。

papers.title: On accessibility of the core in mutidimensional spatial majority voting situations
papers.abstract: In this paper we consider situations of (multidimensional) spatial majority voting. We analyze such situations having an even number (greater than or equal to 4) of voters and assume that each voter's preference over the set of policies is ``Euclidean": i.e., each voter has a most preferred ``ideal" policy and the voter's pay-offs from policies decrease as the (Euclidean) distance of the policies from the ideal policy goes up. We confine attention to voting situations for which the core has a single element belonging to the interior of the policy set. It is known that under conditions usual in this literature, this element of the core, generally, is not a Condorcet winner: i.e., there is at least one policy outside the core such that the core-policy cannot be reached from it by just one round of majority domination. We demonstrate that, however, under such conditions, starting from any policy in place, by a finite sequence of majority-dominations (we assume, implicitly, sincere voting) the policy in the core is reached eventually.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在本文中，我们研究了（多维）空间多数投票的情形。我们分析了选民人数为偶数（大于或等于4）的情况，并假设每位选民对政策集合的偏好具有“欧几里得”性质：即每位选民都有一个最偏好的“理想”政策，且选民从各种政策中获得的收益会随着这些政策与理想政策的“欧几里得”距离增加而减少。我们关注的是那些核心集合中仅包含一个位于政策集内部的元素的投票情形。众所周知，在该领域常见的条件下，这个核心元素通常不是康德赛特赢家（Condorcet winner）——也就是说，至少存在一个不在核心集内的政策，无法通过单轮多数投票从该政策达到核心政策。然而，我们证明了在这样的条件下，从任意一个初始政策出发，通过一系列有限的多数投票过程（我们隐含地假设投票是真诚的），最终能够达到核心中的政策。。
